events.fact: Slack apps can be distributed to other workspaces or published to the Slack Marketplace without a mandatory review if distributed via OAuth URL or private distribution, but Marketplace listing requires formal submission and review.
Slack API does not require a paid developer plan; all standard Web API calls are included across workspace tiers, governed by per-method rate limit tiers (Tiers 1-4 and Special).
